threshold.criterion_1: cosine >= 0.999 against sparse exact diagonalisation at sufficient chi, L = [8, 10, 12, 14]
threshold.criterion_2: bond dimension needed, mapped across family, K, mu and L
threshold.criterion_4: eigenvalue and bond dimension recorded after every sweep

measured.method: two-site DMRG (quimb), bond dimension capped at chi, cutoff 1e-12, eigenvalue tolerance 1e-08 relative, at most 30 sweeps per rung

notes: Criterion 3 is recorded separately in results/wp6/g_6_3.json.
